definitions.explanation: Each and every year; annually. Used to express something that happens on a yearly basis. Functions as both a noun and an adverb.

examples.japanese: {毎年|まいとし}{夏|なつ}に{海|うみ}へ{行|い}きます。
examples.english: I go to the beach every summer.

examples.japanese: {毎年|まいとし}{何|なに}をしますか。
examples.english: What do you do every year?

examples.japanese: {毎年|まいとし}{正月|しょうがつ}には{家族|かぞく}に{会|あ}います。
examples.english: I see my family every New Year.

examples.japanese: {毎年|まいとし}{夏|なつ}は{暑|あつ}いですね。{水|みず}をたくさん{飲|の}みます。
examples.english: It's hot every summer, isn't it? I drink a lot of water.

examples.japanese: {私|わたし}は{毎年|まいとし}{日本|にほん}に{行|い}きます。{今年|ことし}も{行|い}きたいです。
examples.english: I go to Japan every year. I want to go this year too.

notes: Can also be read as まいねん; both readings are equally correct. Related expressions: {去年|きょねん} (last year), {今年|ことし} (this year), {来年|らいねん} (next year). The まいねん reading is slightly more formal.
